notes: Open-end mutual fund reorganization (N-14 filed January 8, 2021 by Managed Portfolio Series): Delaware U.S. Growth Fund, a series of Delaware Group Adviser Funds, into Jackson Square Large-Cap Growth Fund, a series of Managed Portfolio Series; kind merger per the instructions, fund_type open_end_fund. No exchange tickers are printed in the excerpt, so subject_tickers is null. subject_names lists both funds; no single quote under ~300 characters names both, so the span shows the target and the acquirer's name is quoted in the acquirer span. Holders receive shares of the corresponding Acquiring Fund class (Class A/C/R -> Investor Class, Institutional -> Institutional, R6 -> IS Class) equal in aggregate NAV; security_class 'common' is my reading of ordinary open-end fund shares across several classes (no enum fits multi-class mutual fund shares exactly). Meeting date: the letter, notice and Q&A say March 23, 2021, but the proxy statement cover says 'March 23, 2020' (an apparent typo); 2021-03-23 used. Expected close: the shareholder letter says 'on or about April [16], 2021' (bracketed placeholder) and the Q&A says 'on or around April 16, 2021'; the unbracketed Q&A value is used. Conditions: only shareholder approval is stated as a condition in the excerpt; the filing says the Target Fund 'anticipates receiving a legal opinion' on tax consequences but does not state it as a closing condition, and the Plan summary (Exhibit B) falls after the excerpt cut, so tax_opinion is not tagged. JSP and DMC bear the reorganization costs. No collar or outside termination date stated.
